messages:
Sasha: Quick follow-up on yesterday's runtime <-> profile split. I propose the runtime takes only a quant_profile_id + a tiny runtime hint bag (quality_budget, max_latency_ms). Full profile lives in the profile service and can evolve separately. Rationale: keep runtime surface minimal and avoid breaking hotpaths. Thoughts?

Alex: I see the value, but we need a mechanism for cheap compatibility checks. If runtime is totally blind it can't reject incompatible kernels. Suggest adding an optional lightweight whitelist field: allowed_bitpaths = ["fp8","int8","int4"]. That lets runtime validate without pulling the full profile.

Nina: Also concerned about silent quality regressions. We should have adaptive telemetry that samples outputs after any low-bitpath switch. Proposal: sample X requests per minute, compute a primary signal (perplexity_delta for chat) and a secondary (degscore). If signal exceeds threshold across Y consecutive windows, auto-fallback to safe path and alert.

David: Agree. Make thresholds absolute and include a min_tokens_sampled to avoid noisy decisions for low-volume endpoints. Also add a time_window_secs for aggregation.

deploy-bot: canary flag set: quant.canary.enabled=true for service=chat region=us-east-1 :white_check_mark:

Sasha: Drafting an example profile + runtime hints for discussion:
```
id: qp-2026-03-chat-econ-v01
allowed_bitpaths: [fp8,int8,int4]
fallback_policy: graceful  # graceful|immediate|disable
canary_enabled: true
canary_sample_rate: 0.01
telemetry_signal: perplexity_delta
telemetry_threshold: 0.08
telemetry_min_tokens: 2000
telemetry_time_window_secs: 300
runtime_hints:
  quality_budget: 0.92
  max_latency_ms: 180
```
Note: this is illustrative; we'll use numeric types in the canonical schema.

Alex: One more: runtime should log a warning and default to highest-fidelity path if allowed_bitpaths absent for backward compatibility.

Nina: I'll own the canary runbook + dashboards. Action items: PR to infra to add canary flags, PR for profile service schema, runtime API PR accepting quant_profile_id + hints, and a migration plan for legacy profiles. I'll open tickets and link them here.

Sasha: Thanks. I'll prepare the runtime API PR that only passes id and runtime_hints and includes a strict opt-in for allowed_bitpaths. We'll add a small validation shim in the runtime to keep checks cheap.

David: Sounds good. Add a field `min_tokens_sampled` and `consecutive_windows` to the follow-up RFC so SRE can tune alerts.

Nina: Will do. Expect PRs and runbook draft by EOD tomorrow. :memo:
